title: User triggers parent completion
userStory: As a developer, I want to manually complete a feature so that I decide when it's truly done.
acceptanceCriteria: Parent does NOT auto-complete when children finish
Parent shows 'All stories complete - Ready to finalize?'
User can add notes/summary before completing
User can reopen stories if something was missed
User can complete with incomplete children (explicit override with reason required)
Aggregate stats shown: total time, PRs created, iterations
